From Fig. 2F (p. 4), which plots the proportion of plasmids identified in *S. marcescens* by predicted host range:

| Predicted host range | Plasmid proportion |
|---|---|
| Genus | 23.9 % |
| Family | 11.3 % |
| Order | 30.2 % |
| Class | 2.7 % |
| Phylum | 9.0 % |
| Multi-phyla | 22.9 % |

(Fig. 2 and its legend appear on p. 4; the related text on p. 2 notes that *S. marcescens* harbours ~73 % of the plasmids identified in *Serratia*, ~72 % of which are conjugative or mobilizable.)
